value.title: Double-seat warning: one code, stray-pane refusals, hooks, notice

value.principles: Reuse, don't re-derive. The session-record witness already exists twice: revive's conversation_live_elsewhere (crates/daemon/src/http/revive.rs ~147) and pij_harnesses::proc::claude_session_records with process_start_matches_utc_record. Extract one shared daemon helper (e.g. conversation_live_as_seat(state, harness, session) -> Option<LiveCopy{seat, pane, pid, proc_start}>) and make revive, adopt and the stray-pane path all call it, so the three cannot drift. The code string E-RS-CONVERSATION-LIVE is defined once in Rust; the shell scripts match it as a literal, and a test pins that the literal the scripts grep equals the Rust constant (cross-runtime literal seam). The notice goes through the ordinary delivery path and is deduped by a spine event read; the read is bounded to the seat and the event kind. Scripts stay POSIX sh, exit 0, bounded, and print hook JSON only on the coded refusal.
value.composition_root: crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs (adopt and pane resolution) with the shared live-copy helper; harness/scripts/*.sh for the human-facing surfaces
contracts: E-RS-CONVERSATION-LIVE: one Rust constant; leads the refusal text; --json details {code, seat, pane, harness_session, pid}
spine kind seat.double-detected {seat, stray_pane, stray_pid, proc_start, harness_session}: audit and dedupe record for the notice
shared helper conversation_live_as_seat(state, harness, session) -> Option<LiveCopy>, used by revive, adopt and the stray-pane path
seams: crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs: adopt refusal (~818) and pane resolution's not-registered refusal (~1264)
crates/daemon/src/http/revive.rs: conversation_live_elsewhere becomes a caller of the shared helper

harness/scripts/claude-session-start-pij.sh, claude-user-prompt-submit-pij.sh, claude-statusline-pij.sh (embedded via include_str! in crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs; the daemon installs them)

value.rationale: One detection surfaced at four points that share one helper and one code string; splitting would freeze an interface for a single consumer. One coder implements; a cross-model reviewer reviews; the prime verifies.

value.path: pane resolution miss -> caller session record -> shared helper -> refused(E-RS-CONVERSATION-LIVE)
SessionStart hook -> adopt refusal code -> systemMessage + additionalContext
UserPromptSubmit hook -> activity/fyi-claim refusal code -> systemMessage + additionalContext
status line -> whoami/adopt refusal code -> red double segment
coded refusal -> spine seat.double-detected read/write -> one delivery to the live seat

value.text: The stray-pane check adds a filesystem scan to every unresolved pane lookup and slows refusals.
value.check: The scan runs only on the refusal path (pane unowned), never on a resolved pane; a test pins that a resolved pane does not read the sessions dir.

value.text: A recycled pid's stale session record raises a false double.
value.check: Same pid+proc_start match as revive; a test with a mismatched start expects today's not-registered text.

value.text: The notice loops or repeats across restarts.
value.check: Spine-event dedupe test across a simulated restart; mutation receipt deleting the dedupe.

value.text: The hooks print malformed JSON and break the human's prompt.
value.check: Script tests parse the hook output with jq/serde and assert exit 0 on every path.
